fields.value: etude fetch fails on large outputs: transfer observations are recorded off the invoking thread

Found 2026-10-27 in the eb70f8 GPU demo. Fetching a 33.9 MB output tar failed twice with `sqlite3.ProgrammingError: SQLite objects created in a thread can only be used in that same thread`; a 575-byte receipt fetched fine. The download runs parts on worker threads (`etude/launch/storage/download.py:81`, then `:138 _part`, then `:165 _get`). The S3 transport's transfer observation (`storage/transport.py:177 request`, then `:107 emit`, then `:116 deliver`) reaches `launch/database.py:207 retain_transfer_json` / `:210 retain_transfer` on that worker thread. AGENTS.md: emit transfer observations on the invoking thread so database retention keeps its connection ownership.

Outcome: `etude fetch` of a multi-part output succeeds, with transfer observations retained on the invoking thread. A test fetches a multi-part object through the real download path and asserts on the result and the retained observations.

Requested by Jack Heart, 2026-10-27 (found by the eb70f8 demo).
